body.query: query ($first: Int!, $cursor: String) { staffMembers(first: $first, after: $cursor) { nodes { id email name firstName lastName active accountType isShopOwner exists } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } }

request.readOnlyPostReason: Shopify's GraphQL Admin API only accepts POST requests; this is a read-only query with no mutation.

usage.reason: The staff member record has no last-login or last-active field, and the supplied documentation describes no audit log or per-user activity report for staff.

evidence.quote: Every GraphQL Admin API request carries an access token in the X-Shopify-Access-Token header.
You can retrieve up to a maximum of 250 resources.
Returns a paginated list of Staff Member
Requires read _users access scope. Also: The app must be a finance embedded app or installed on a Shopify Plus or Advanced store.
The GraphQL Admin API is rate-limited using calculated query costs, measured in cost points.
THROTTLED The client has exceeded the rate limit

assumptions: The errorEnvelope is a best guess: Shopify returns an 'errors' array in a 200 response, and I couldn't express 'errors is absent' exactly, so the runtime may need to treat a non-empty errors field as failure.
Only the access token header is documented for server access. Shopify's OAuth and client-credentials token grants are mentioned but not detailed in the source, so they are not listed.
The staff list needs the read_users scope and a Shopify Plus or Advanced store (or a finance embedded app). Shopify Support must enable the scope for the app.
The source shows no last-active or login-time field for staff, and no audit log, so usage is marked unavailable.
The staff record has no created-at field in the source, so createdAt is left empty.
The account type 'invited' and 'requested' are treated as members; their status is based on the 'active' flag only. The mapping of account types to member or guest is my judgment.
The GraphQL cursor variable name ($cursor) and page-size variable ($first) are chosen by me in the query. The page size of 250 is the documented maximum.
Role is set to the raw accountType because the source has no separate role field.
The API version 2026-10 is the one labeled latest in the source and is hardcoded in the path; it will need updating when Shopify retires it.
The rate limit is point-based (cost points), not requests per minute, so no per-minute figure is given.

User listing needs Shopify Plus or Advanced.
